Formula Atomic minimum of non-negative f32 cost bits: c[v] <- min(c[v], f32(c[u] + w[u,v])). Negative/NaN weights are impassable; out-of-range neighbors and non-finite candidates are ignored. With cutoff L, candidates above L stay unreached (+Infinity); without a cutoff L = +Infinity. At convergence c[v] = min_s(c0[s] + d(s,v)), restricted to <= L, with path sums evaluated in f32. Chaotic: a visit may read costs improved earlier in the same round; rounds are not synchronous Bellman-Ford sweeps.
